intro: When a long reserve of heavy braid is part of your offshore plan, the 2026 Certate SW 20000-H is rated for 330 yards of 100 lb J-Braid. Its listed weight is 31.6 oz and retrieve is 54.4 inches per turn, making it a substantial setup rather than a light-tackle choice. Daiwa's POWERDRIVE DESIGN belongs to this 2026 generation. Choose your line below to estimate a full fill or optional backing.
